name: 84107 · Murray, UT
findings: ZIP 84107 (Murray) has 189 nonprofit organizations. 93 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 70 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84107 (Murray) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 84107 (Murray) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 49 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
